threads.body: The removed line appears to have been unnumbered/indented differently than the surrounding lines, while the new line is numbered. If this file is intended to be plain `pip` requirements, the line-number prefixes can be confusing and may break tooling that expects `package==version` lines only. Consider keeping formatting consistent (either remove all line numbers, or ensure the numbering is generated consistently across the whole file) to avoid brittle parsing in CI scripts.
